# Change Order: CRM Connector

The signed scope covers the reporting dashboard. You requested an additional CRM connector. The original fee excludes this work.

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| **Scope** | Build a CRM connector |
| **Estimate** | 40 hours at $175/hour |
| **Fixed Fee** | $7,000 |
| **Schedule** | Adds two weeks |

The two-week duration begins after we receive your written approval and sandbox credentials. This figure is an estimate; the calendar date depends on when those items arrive.

Approve this proposal in writing before connector work starts. Decline it to keep the original dashboard scope, fee, and schedule intact.
